title: C4 group-action Mirror expert views
hypothesis: A paid C4 group element address applied to one shared non-equivariant linear expert will reconstruct its related conjugate expert views with held-out nMSE <=1e-10 and lower actual payload bytes than four independent experts; it will expose the orbit stabilizer (fewer distinct functions than addresses), while a group-external fifth task requires private state. A direct coefficient control at comparable bytes determines whether the benefit is group-structured compression or Mirror-specific.
physical_object: one 2x2 linear expert matrix W shared across C4-related tasks
mirror_coordinate: 2-bit C4 group element address selecting R_k W R_k^T
logical_multiplicity: four addressed C4 views plus one deliberately unrelated task with private residual
controls: group-action Mirror base+addresses plus private fifth expert
direct ordinary per-task matrix coefficients for the same four related views plus private fifth expert

development.selection_metric: held-out function nMSE, actual serialized payload bytes, unique output-function count, operation count

storage.authority: actual deterministic ZIP/NPY FP32 inference payload bytes after reload

success_gate: All fresh seeds: group-action held-out nMSE <=1e-10 on related views; total payload at least 20% below independent five-expert payload when fifth private task is included; group-action and direct coefficient control reported at actual bytes; unrelated task nMSE <=1e-10 only when its private matrix is paid. Do not claim Mirror-specific value if direct control matches within 10% bytes and quality.
failure_gate: Related-view quality misses 1e-10, or compression is below 20% versus independent experts, or claimed four-view multiplicity collapses under measured output-function equivalence, or the group-action representation is dominated by the direct control by >10% bytes at equal quality.
amendment: Exploratory/screen seeds 33511-33519 are retained and excluded from confirmatory verdicts. A control implementation audit found a sign error in the direct C4 irreducible-coefficient decoder, which caused false poor quality. Correct the decoder, validate on development seeds 33501-33502, and freeze fresh seeds 33520-33522 before confirmatory access. Compact uint8 addresses and gates remain unchanged.
selection_rule: Development seeds 33501-33502 validate the corrected coefficient control. All earlier fresh-labeled seeds are exploratory only. Confirmatory seeds are 33520-33522.
boundaries: synthetic post-fit linear expert functions, not trained MoE or language-model evidence
group addresses do not count as independent capacity
C4 conjugation has a nontrivial stabilizer; report unique functions rather than address count
exact equivariance and non-equivariant specialization are reported separately
no optimizer updates; target matrices are analytic constructions
